summary: TypeScript SDK: EventSource-based streaming chat freezes in long-running sessions
description: Customer reports TS SDK streaming chat intermittently freezes after ~20-30 minutes of continuous use (many conversations). They use the browser build with EventSource transport. No error; onmessage stops firing. Workaround is full page refresh.
comments: Support (Vanessa): Collected browser version, memory profile, and a minimal repro that creates many EventSource instances.
Eng (Dylan): Found we were leaking EventSource handles when consumers stop iterating early; should close() when iterator is GC'd/aborted.
Eng (Dylan): Implemented explicit .return() handler on async iterator to close EventSource; added docs for always breaking the loop with try/finally. Released 2.4.2.
Support (Vanessa): Customer confirmed freeze no longer occurs with 2.4.2.
